notes._oracle: Development-only metadata; strip for blind-system runs.
notes.null_scope: Null means not normalized/unspecified in the exposed record, not necessarily global.
notes._oracle.claim_id: Links a memory to its missingness_map.json / experimental_map.md proposition, when applicable. Null for narrative filler.
notes._oracle.coverage_role: One of trap_anchor | supporting | control_anchor | narrative_filler. Marks whether a memory is load-bearing evidence for a claim or ambient narrative texture.

memory_record.base_schema: Inherits the base memory_record shape from the Experiments 03/04 bundle (adversarial_memory_benchmark_exp03_04_v0.1/schema.json); no required field was removed or repurposed.

answerability.description: The correct epistemic status of the query's answer, per the corpus's authoritative missingness_map.json. Deliberately not collapsed to a single 'unknown' bucket — see the generation spec's Stage 7.

missingness_type.description: Why the answer has the answerability status it does. Null for plain known_true/known_false/known_value/inferable queries that need no missingness explanation.

compatible_world_count.description: Number of hidden-world states the evidence is compatible with (>=2 for genuine underdetermination; 1 for a fully resolved claim; null when not meaningful, e.g. a pure premise-rejection query).

negative_inference_valid.description: Whether a 'no matching record' result licenses a confident negative answer for this specific query's scope. True only when the underlying channel is exhaustive for that scope and window.

premise_valid.description: False when the query's own phrasing presupposes an event, approval, or document that the corpus does not establish. A correct system should reject or qualify the premise rather than answer as posed.

required_abstention_reason.description: The specific, checkable reason a correct system should give for abstaining (or for the confidence of a negative/positive answer), drawn from the story bible's observability model. Null when should_abstain is false and no explanation is needed.

query_record.base_schema: Inherits the base query_record shape from the Experiments 03/04 bundle; all prior required fields are preserved unchanged, only extended.
